name: SPX Express Singapore
notes: Official site spx.sg (b: serving domain; robots.txt Sitemap -> /sitemap/index.xml, 31 URLs; no scam/security page in sitemap). Support FAQ https://spx.sg/en/support-center/faq is JS-rendered (curl returns only the title; one WebFetch attempt also saw only the title) - recorded and moved on. Homepage footer gives address 'Shopee Building, Singapore 118265' and links careers.shopee.sg, hence parent_entity_id shopee.sg (Shopee logistics arm). No SPX-published scam page, sender ID, hotline or social links found. SPX impersonation is covered by Shopee help article 204789 '[Scam-Advisory] Delivery Impersonation Scams' (see shopee.sg record) and by SPF advisories 2026-07-15 and 2026-08-05/2026-08-20 on courier/iMessage phishing naming SPX (unverified (search snippet); belong to SPF registry).
